ITEM 1 | Pale green thin green beans, slender pods about 0.5 cm wide and 8-10 cm long, matte with slight sheen, clustered at top-left of plate above the greens | 25
ITEM 2 | Mixed salad greens: broad and crinkled leaves in bright to dark green with some reddish-purple edges, slightly glossy and limp, spread across right half and bottom of plate, roughly 15 cm across | 60
ITEM 3 | Golden-brown pan-seared chicken piece, breaded or seasoned crust with visible flecks, moist and tender interior edges, roughly 7 x 5 cm and about 2.5 cm thick, sitting at bottom-left of plate | 130
ITEM 4 | Golden-brown seared chicken piece with crisp crust and light glossy sheen, roughly 6 x 4 cm and about 2 cm thick, sitting center-left, partly overlapping the greens and beans | 90
ITEM 5 | Small scattered crumbs, tan-brown and dry, a few pieces near top-left edge of the plate | 2
